item.title: 21-year-old man dead in Benton Harbor shooting
item.description: BENTON HARBOR, Mich. -- In the early morning hours of Feb. 1, officers with the Benton Harbor Department of Public Safety responded to reports of shots-fired in 600 block of Columbus Avenue.

item.title: Notre Dame celebrates 50 years of women’s varsity athletics with ‘Cheer Her Name’ initiative
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The university launched its first women’s varsity sport — tennis — in 1976, just two years after women were first admitted to Notre Dame. From that starting point, women’s athletics continued to expand alongside the broader national movement following the passage of Title IX in 1972.

item.title: Playing P.I.G with top rebounder Carson Towt
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- ABC57 Tipoff host Vahid Sadrzadeh catches up with Notre Dame's top rebounder Carson Towt in a knockout game of P.I.G.

item.title: HSSJC hosting February adoption event in Mishawaka
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- Humane Society of St. Jospeh County is holding an adoption event Feb.7 at Pet Smart in Mishawaka for people to find their forever pet.

item.title: We Make Indiana highlights mental health crisis services
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Over 450 community members and leaders of St. Joseph County gathered at Islamic Society of Michiana for their We Make Indiana event focusing on mental health crisis services.

item.title: Fighting Irish defeat Stanford 78-66 Sunday
item.description: PALO ALTO, Calif. -- The Irish hold another win over Standford, 78-66, inside Maples Pavilion Sunday evening.

item.title: Galentine Small Shops coming to The Grand LV
item.description: NILES, Mich. -- The Grand LV will be hosting Galentine Small Shops on Saturday, Feb. 7, for best friends who celebrate Galentine's Day.

item.title: South Bend Record Show kicks off new year at Giuseppe Center
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The South Bend Record show held its first event of the year at the Giuseppe Center on Feb. 1.

item.title: Democratic Socialists of America organize the South Bend community against ICE
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Members of the Northern Indiana chapter of the Democratic Socialists of America held simultaneous anti-ICE protests Sunday, including a demonstration in South Bend where organizers issued formal demands to local leaders.
